methodSections.heading: Eggs Royale
steps: Pre-heat oven to 180°C (350°F). Place asparagus spears on roasting tray and drizzle with olive oil, salt and fresh cracked pepper. Roast for 10 minutes or until bright green and just cooked, and set aside.

In a large mixing bowl, whisk the eggs, cream and salt and pepper. In a large non-stick fry-pan melt, the unsalted butter and add the green onions on a medium to low heat and cook until just fragrant. Add the egg and cream mixture to the pan.
